paragraphs: R. Mana bar Tanḥum. R. Ḥiyya bar Abba went to Tyre and found that he had permitted lupines. He told R. Yoḥanan, who asked why he had not excommunicated him. He answered, 'He is a great man and knows how to sweeten the sea.' R. Yoḥanan said he knew the hour when the waters praise the Holy One, when they become sweet; R. Zakkai of Alexandria also knew it, Jerusalem Talmud, Avodah Zarah 2, halakhah 9. In R. Ḥanina's name, Jerusalem Talmud, Terumot 8, halakhah 6. Yosa—that is Rav Assi—in his name, Jerusalem Talmud, Kiddushin 1, halakhah 3; HaDar, and Ma'aser Sheni 4, halakhah 3. He was R. Yaakov bar Yefaliti's wedding attendant.
